error_metric: each lane's own, as its rows state: PC, GES, and the other CPDAG methods by the shd of the learned CPDAG against the true graph's CPDAG; FCI by endpoint shd; GFCI in the EBIC lane by the PAG family's pair-level shd; exact_search by its CPDAG shd against the true CPDAG. The bootstrap lane judges edge frequencies against the true CPDAG (pc, ges) or the true DAG (direct_lingam). A fit that did not finish is a status, never an empty graph, and enters no median.

boundary.fits: one fit at a time per 4-CPU slot of a shared node, a 3600 s wall cap and a 28000 MB memory cap per fit, 5 datasets per rung (10 when the median is within 10% of the empty graph's; 20 cause-effect pairs per rung for anm and pnl)

ebic.fits: one fit at a time on one CPU (1 worker), a 900 s wall cap and a 10 GB memory cap per fit; both gammas on the same dataset; a dataset whose fit did not finish at either gamma has no pair and is outside the difference

missing_values.fits: one fit at a time on one CPU (1 worker), a 900 s wall cap and a 6 GB memory cap per fit; 10 datasets per row

bootstrap.fits: one fit at a time on one CPU (1 worker), a 3000 s wall cap and a 6 GB memory cap per dataset; 10 datasets per row, 100 resamples each

boundary.disclaimer: For reference, measured on the data generators named in each ladder with the settings listed per ladder; not a hard limit.
boundary.note: This lane is the 0.10.0 boundary lane, carried over unchanged: its ladders were measured for the 0.10.0 release (builds lists the Andrey builds that ran them) and were not run again on the 0.11.0 build. A ladder steps one quantity on one regime until a stop; its axis is 'd' (variables; hidden and latent nodes count where a regime has them), 'n' (rows: the pair methods, whose d is 2) or 'latents' (gin: a rung's d counts each latent variable and its 3 indicators, 4 per latent, and 3 per latent are observed), and its label describes the regime in plain words (tau is the lag window of a time-series method). A rung is through when fewer than 3 of its fits did not finish within the caps (a timeout, an out-of-memory kill, or an error); median_errors is over the finished fits and null when none finished, so a fit that did not finish never counts as an empty graph. beats_empty compares the median errors with the empty graph's. median_time_s is null on a rung whose fits ran on two CPU models (cpu names both). A regime 'degK-nN' has mean degree K and N rows at every d; 'degK-nMd' has M x d rows. A ladder ends with stop 'time', 'memory' or 'error' (3 fits of a rung did not finish), 'accuracy' (two rungs in a row did not beat the empty graph), or 'ladder_end' (the last planned rung); end.hand_stopped marks an accuracy stop set by hand after larger rungs had run, and those rungs stay. beats_empty_through_d is the largest d up to which every rung is through and beats the empty graph; last_through_d and first_not_beating_d are on the same axis, and a ladder with axis 'n' carries all three as *_n (rows) with the *_d fields null. params holds the keyword arguments of the public andrey.<method>(data, **params) call whose values differ from its defaults ({} when all are defaults), and params_note says where a setting's meaning on this release differs from the build that ran it; generators gives the call that draws each dataset of a rung, with the rung's d, n, mean degree and seed.

protocol.calls: andrey.<method>(X, ebic_gamma=gamma) at the method's other defaults, for gamma 0.0 and 1.0 on every dataset; boss and grasp with seed=0; rsmax2 as restrict='pc', maximize='tabu' (its default, mmpc with hc, is mmhc's search)
protocol.score: the linear-Gaussian BIC plus the extended-BIC term 2 * gamma * log C(d - 1, parents)

missing_values.description: SHD of PC and FCI on data with missing values: test-wise deletion (the default), listwise deletion (drop incomplete rows, then fit), the same data complete, and the empty graph; PC is scored by CPDAG SHD, FCI by endpoint SHD

patterns.mcar: each cell missing independently with probability `rate`
patterns.mar: even-indexed columns always observed; an odd column is missing in a row with probability sigmoid(a + 2 z), z the standardized observed column before it, a set so `rate` is the share of all cells missing

protocol.data: andrey.data.sample_scm at its defaults: Erdos-Renyi graph, linear, Gaussian noise, standardized, columns shuffled, mean degree 2
protocol.fits: andrey.pc and andrey.fci with indep_test fisherz or student_t, other settings at their defaults
protocol.complete_data: rate 0.0: the complete data fitted once; testwise, listwise, and complete arms repeat that fit

bootstrap.description: Bootstrap edge frequencies of pc, ges and direct_lingam, binned in tenths, with the share of each bin's edges that are in the true graph, and the averaged graph's SHD against a single fit on the full data
bootstrap.graph: Erdos-Renyi, standardized (andrey.data defaults); linear Gaussian for pc and ges, linear uniform-noise for direct_lingam
